dialogues.speaker: Stepan
dialogues.text: I really envy them... Unlike me, they weren't left behind just to guard the gate.

dialogues.speaker: Stepan
dialogues.text: The people I joined with. Somehow, they've all been favored and given important assignments.

dialogues.speaker: Stepan
dialogues.text: We joined the Fatui at the same time, but now they all get sent out of Snezhnaya for fieldwork. They get to travel on official funds, and they'll be promoted faster, too.

dialogues.speaker: Stepan
dialogues.text: Meanwhile, I'm stuck here at the Veche gates, in the same weather, staring at the same scenery every day.

dialogues.speaker: Stepan
dialogues.text: Then again, it's not like leaving Snezhnograd is safe. Just look at how many people we've lost in Nod-Krai lately...

dialogues.speaker: Stepan
dialogues.text: Ah, whatever. Maybe this is fine. You have to stay alive before you can worry about moving up.

dialogues.speaker: Stepan
dialogues.text: If I do a good enough job guarding this gate, maybe someday I'll get promoted to guarding one inside the Veche. Not bad, right? Not bad.
